description: This file defines the `AccessPointArn` class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically handling ARN parsing and validation for AWS Access Points.

classes.name: AccessPointArn
classes.description: Represents and validates AWS Access Point ARNs, extending the base Arn class and implementing AccessPointArnInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new AccessPointArn instance and validates its data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into the ARN components specific to an AWS Access Point.

methods.name: getAccesspointName
methods.description: Returns the name of the access point from the ARN data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks specific to Access Point ARNs, such as resource type, resource ID, and hostname validity.
